name: Bondada Engineering Ltd
tagline: Hyderabad telecom-infra + solar/BESS EPC growing ~80% a year at ~39% ROCE and ~15x earnings, with a Rs 7,147 Cr order book (~2.5x FY26 revenue) - a genuine growth story, but an EPC multiple ceiling caps a true 10x
business_overview: Bondada Engineering Ltd (NSE: BONDADA), incorporated 2012, Hyderabad, provides EPC and O&M services to the telecom (towers, OFC - Jio/Airtel/Indus/BSNL) and renewable-energy (solar EPC, solar IPP, BESS) sectors. Renewables were ~79% of FY26 revenue. Founders: B Raghavendra Rao (CMD), S Baratam (CFO).
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 7,147 Cr (~65% solar EPC, plus BESS and telecom) - ~2.5x FY26 revenue
2026-06-17: NOA Rs 1,338 Cr from NTPC Renewable Energy (250 MW solar PV + 50 MW / 200 MWh BESS), 18-month execution
fundamentals_narrative: Bondada has compounded revenue ~96% (FY25) then ~81% (FY26) to ~Rs 2,843 Cr, with PAT +86% to ~Rs 195 Cr, ~39% ROCE and only ~15x earnings. The Rs 7,147 Cr order book gives ~2.5x-revenue visibility and management guides ~60-70% FY27 growth; the Rs 1,338 Cr NTPC REL award (solar + BESS) is concrete and large. The constraint is what kind of business this is: solar EPC is competitive, working-capital-intensive and bid on thin-to-moderate margins, and the market rarely re-rates EPC contractors much beyond mid-teens P/E. So a 10x from ~Rs 3,182 Cr (to ~Rs 32,000 Cr) needs the earnings to roughly triple AND the multiple to expand sharply - plausible as a 3-5x if execution and the order book hold, harder as a clean 10x. The thread is effectively empty, so there is no independent scrutiny of margin durability or receivables.
